basic_info.description: Beautifully updated 2BR/1.5BA Edwardian condominium in a boutique 4-unit building in prime Richmond District and located just one block from Golden Gate Park. This bright and spacious corner unit is elegantly appointed with a remodeled kitchen, remodeled bathrooms, hardwood floors, large picture windows, and french doors. Freshly painted walls, modern light fixtures, in-unit laundry and a large independent garage with additional storage space complete the home. The convenient location places it within walking distance to Richmond District neighborhood restaurants and shops, along with easy access to public transportation.
